pairs: Tunc miserunt legatos suos universarum urbium ac provinciarum reges ac principes,
Then the kings as well as the princes of the provinces sent their emissaries from all of the cities:
and Libya as well as Cilicia.
melius est enim ut viventes serviamus Nabuchodonosor regi magno,
For it is better for us to live in service to Nebuchadnezzar, the great king,
and to become subject to you,
quam morientes cum interitu nostro ipsi servitutis nostræ damna patiamur.
rather than to die, even though we may have to suffer our condemnation into the annihilation of slavery.
All our cities and all our possessions,
et universæ facultates nostræ atque familiæ, in conspectu tuo sunt:
and all our resources and families are in your sight.
sint omnia nostra sub lege tua.
Let all that we have be subject to your law.
Come to us as a peaceful lord,
Tunc descendit de montibus cum equitibus in virtute magna,
Then he descended from the mountains with horsemen,
and he took charge of every city and of every inhabitant of the land.
De universis autem urbibus assumpsit sibi auxiliarios viros fortes,
And, from all the cities, he took for himself auxiliaries:
strong men and well-chosen for war.
And such a dread lay upon those provinces,
ut universarum urbium habitatores principes et honorati simul cum populis exirent obviam venienti,
that the leading and honored inhabitants of all the cities, together with the people, went out to meet him at his arrival.
excipientes eum cum coronis et lampadibus,
They received him with garlands and lamps;
ducentes choros in tympanis et tibiis.
they were led by choirs with timbrels and flutes.
not even by doing these things were they able to mitigate the ferocity of his chest.
For he both destroyed their cities
and cut down their sacred groves.
Præceperat enim illi Nabuchodonosor rex, ut omnes deos terræ exterminaret,
For king Nebuchadnezzar had instructed him to exterminate all the gods of the earth,
videlicet ut ipse solus diceretur deus ab his nationibus quæ potuissent Holofernis potentia subjugari.
evidently so that he alone might be called ‘god’ by those nations which were able to be subjugated by the power of Holofernes.
But when he had passed through Syria Sobal,
venit ad Idumæos in terram Gabaa,
he came to the Idumeans in the land of Gibeah.
et sedit ibi per triginta dies,
and he sat there for thirty days,
in quibus diebus adunari præcepit universum exercitum virtutis suæ.
during which days he instructed all the troops of his army to regroup.
